title: Burstcoin Blockchain Explorer
summary: High-throughput real-time blockchain telemetry and asset ledger explorer parsing block generation deadlines, smart tokens, and global transaction metrics.
highlights: Real-time daemon RPC ingestion and parsing of 256-bit Shabal-hash Proof-of-Capacity block payloads.
Decentralized on-chain asset exchange tracking, token transfer indexing, and rich address telemetry.
Global high-availability multi-region cloud deployment on AWS EC2 and Google Cloud Platform.
